nodes.label: Honest Assessment of QR Digital Menu App (pre-revenue, strong tech, needs monetization)
nodes.rationale: Strengths: server-side pricing, FIFO loyalty, IPaymentProvider abstraction, timezone-aware Luxon, httpOnly cookies/CSRF/CSP. Gaps: no subscription billing, no CI tests, TS strict off, no observability. P0 breaks: no pagination (false вЂ” actually done), Socket.io CORS wildcard, loyalty expiry TODO. Priority: 1.Pagination, 2.Socket.io CORS, 3.Loyalty emails, 4.Subscription, 5.CI coverage.
